title: [PM seat] domain:skills · seat 2 — ⏳ vacant
body:
**This post is the single authoritative registration of the skills lane's SECOND seat (`domain:skills#2`).** Four-section template; the job description is versioned at `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md` — ⛔ not copied here. Seat 1's post is #7623. Body **r57** (⏳ vacant: the sign-off ledger), written 2026-10-16T13:59Z by `session_01VqGhCg9wdsBXPz54uAEWg7` (os-elon-musk). r56 back to r33 (this shift's seating) and r32 (the previous shift's ledger) are in the edit history, ⛔ not restated.

## Current PM

⏳ **vacant.** `session_01VqGhCg9wdsBXPz54uAEWg7` (os-elon-musk), seated 2026-10-15T11:19Z, signed off 2026-10-16T13:59Z on the maintainer's 「当前任务处理完，合并后就下班」 in that session. The release marker is the shift-end brief comment stamped after this body. A successor reads this post and seats at once with `/pm-dispatch skills`. `check-handover.mjs --session=session_01VqGhCg9wdsBXPz54uAEWg7 --account=os-elon-musk` read clear before this body was written: no unreleased claim, no decision outside the inbox. Seat 1 (#7623) was not re-read at sign-off.

## Inherited ledger

- **Lane at sign-off** (objectstack; objectui 0 open `domain:skills`): `pm:queue` 0; `pm:dispatched` 0 held by this seat; decision box 0; `pm:blocked`, `pm:on-hold`, `pm:retriage` and bare `finding` 0; `tracking` 2 (#22060, #17161).
- **Untouched by this seat:** #23934 (p2, `tooling`, filed 2026-10-16T13:14Z with a filer-applied `domain:skills` and no `pm:*` state). It owes triage's first touch, or a successor's 例外二 check (`references/execution-duties.md` 〈候选与批次〉).
- **This shift landed 11 cards**, each closed by its PR's `Fixes` with a landing comment on the card: #23615, #23662, #23607, #23692, #23768, #23753, #23787, #23665, #23733, #23770, #23860; #23606 went to seat 1 (yield note on the card). The shift-end brief lists them with PRs and merge commits.
- **Maintainer questions open on cards (non-blocking, not decision cards):**
  - #23787 6207817517: the three cases with no app-declarable door (a third-party-signed callback, a streaming response, an unspoken protocol). The seat recommends A, keep the gap, for each.
  - #23733 6205096053: first-touch labels for cards claimed under 例外二.
  - #23692 6205078148: does `yes (narrowing)` route to the narrowing face?
  - **Not on any card:** whether to file a decision card for `editMode` against `navigation.mode` (ADR-0085 §2), escalated by PR #23795's at-tier review. It was asked in chat only. #23934's subject (「卡先于弹窗」) says such a question belongs on a card; a successor files it if the maintainer has not answered.
- **Follow-ups carried (pointers, not cards under the filing gate):**
  - #23860's live pin (6217094606): the next maintainer-confirmed `.changeset/pre/` correction made by an auto-mode dev without a refusal.
  - The 「rate limit」 clause shared by PR #23807's skill text and PR #23785's retire text should read 「endpoint rate-limit budget」. Pointer for `domain:spec` seat 1: 6207969413 on #23216.
  - From PR #23795's at-tier review, no measured `reach:`: objectui console task flows ignore the derived surface (F1); the view flow derives without a viewport (F2); `record-surface.ts`'s header docblock still says 「full page」 (F3).
  - Stale 「three contract faces」 text after PR #23750: `record-recognisers.mjs` L113–114, `references/lanes/ui.md` L38, and three frozen `dispatch-gates*.mjs` comments.
  - `os-dev.md`'s report JSON template lacks the `deviations`, `line_budget` and `files_changed` keys that dispatch orders ask for.
  - `references/platform-readings.md` L171 documents the single-issue page payload path that live readings contradict (`payload.issueViewerRoute…`).

## Hot-file serial queue

None held by this seat. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` · `dispatch-gates.data.mjs` · `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`: FROZEN (ruling 208 R6). Every other lane file: FREE.

## Notes

- **Write paths:** content writes only through `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`, `label-write.mjs`, `issue-create.mjs`, `close-cards.mjs` and `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`, on route `dispatch` (the relay `fleet-write.yml` on `main`). ⛔ No MCP write.
- **Platform fact (this shift's one seat error):**
  - `.claude/settings.json` allow-lists the bare `node scripts/pm/{label-write,post-stamped,close-cards,issue-create}.mjs *` and `node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs *` commands. `landing-operations.md` L52 says to type them unwrapped.
  - This seat wrapped them in `cd … && … > log; echo` for most of the shift. The auto-mode classifier then refused the Tier S landing strokes and a label removal, and the maintainer had to authorize by hand.
  - Run bare, every stroke since passed.
  - Separately, any write to `.claude/**` is a protected-path write. No allow row pre-approves it, so in auto mode it is refused as `[Self-Modification]`; it needs the maintainer's own prompt approval (#23860).
- **Harness:** CURRENT at `8f4260fe6`. The shared checkout's mirror branch `claude/lucid-pascal-gg89y8` is pushed and in sync.
- **Timers and sessions:**
  - The patrol Routine `trig_0146Bbf4fhg7HqoFCFCYGvWw` is deleted at sign-off.
  - `subscribe_pr_activity`: none open; every watch ended at its merge.
  - Every dev and reviewer ran `mode:subagent`; no cloud session was created, so there is nothing to archive.
  - No worktree remains beside the shared checkout.
